notes: Only candidate assets are written. Gameplay distance, damage windows, input and recovery locks are unchanged.
All eight run entry phases are authored. Preparation uses elapsed sprint readiness, never time remaining until a future click.
Mesh warps only transition pixels. Original attack PNGs and approved sword trajectory data are not edited.
Source pixels switch at the middle of a matched-pose bridge; no alpha crossfade or double-body overlay.
Thrust uses a new shield arm instead of the original overlapping two-hand reach.
Landmarks are manual 2D authoring data, not measured 3D bones or runtime verification.
Candidate only. 600ms active thrust, zero added windup, 500ms recovery.
Preparation bends the elbow; first 100ms sends the shoulder and sword forward.
Torso/legs use source-pixel mesh. Separate arm cutouts retain fixed bone lengths.
No camera shake, new VFX, damage, hit timing or physical displacement changes.
